name: Satou Tadanobu
source:
A warrior from the late Heian period. She is one of Yoshitsune's Four Heavenly Kings. She is brave and bold in nature, and a skilled archer. She is also deeply loyal, and does not hesitate to speak her mind even to those above her.

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming[/url]]
